mapper.insert: insert into agent_memory ( memory_key, agent_code, symbol, memory_type, market_regime, event_tags_json, direction, action, lesson_text, evidence_json, outcome_json, quality_score, confidence, source_trace_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{memoryKey}, #{agentCode}, #{symbol}, #{memoryType}, #{marketRegime}, #{eventTagsJson}, #{direction}, #{action}, #{lessonText}, #{evidenceJson}, #{outcomeJson}, #{qualityScore}, #{confidence}, #{sourceTraceId}, #{enabled}, now(), now() )

insert into agent_memory_usage (trace_id, symbol, memory_id, agent_code, usage_context_json, outcome_json) values (#{traceId}, #{symbol}, #{memoryId}, #{agentCode}, #{usageContextJson}, #{outcomeJson})
mapper.update: update agent_memory set usage_count = usage_count + 1, last_used_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update agent_memory set enabled = 0, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
